title: [3.0-Beta4] Duplicate entries/rows in Statistics page.
body:
On Statistics Page, under Average (70-180) and Average (70-140) duplicate entries exist.

Enter Statistics page from 3ple dots menu on top right of AAPS.

Device: Xiaomi Mi6 (Android 9)
